scope: Read-only metadata preflight for the 25 schemas currently represented by the verified COST onboarding, expanded to all available symbol/dataset history. No historical records downloaded and no paid requests submitted. Excludes new venues, deferred cmbp-1/mbp-1 schemas, full SEC document archive, FMP complete history, operational derived-feature expansion and shared CME extensions.
plan_window_method: Plan-window scenario uses full L0 availability, 365 days L1 and 31 days L2/L3 per local Standard-plan inventory, subject to current actual quoted cost; it is not presumed free.
storage_method: Provider record count multiplied by corresponding measured COST native-plus-Parquet bytes per record. Compression/partitioning may differ substantially across dates and symbols. Estimates are not bounds or free-workspace requirements.

corporate_history_context.sec_size_caveat: SEC-reported submission sizes are not final compressed local archive sizes; storing original documents, exhibits and extracted text changes the physical result. These are separate from market-archive estimates.
corporate_history_context.fmp_size_caveat: Income, balance-sheet and cash-flow responses for annual and quarterly periods only; not a census of every FMP product or final raw/normalized storage.
corporate_history_context.CME: Existing shared CME history is reused by additional equity symbols. Extending that shared history is a separate scope and is not included in these per-company market archive quotes.

interpretation: The earlier approximately 2.7 GiB estimate applied to bounded onboarding windows, not full available company history across data families.

Full-available scenario includes the 25 Databento schemas in the verified COST onboarding, from later of the supplied listing date and dataset/schema start through September 11, 2026. It does not cover every market venue or additional deferred schemas.

Plan-window scenario uses full L0 data, up to 365 calendar days of L1 and 31 days of L2/L3. It is aligned approximately with local plan documentation but actual quotes are nonzero; no claim that all requested windows are free.
Compression extrapolation from COST is approximate. Final capacity, working space, derived features, models and any shared-history expansion require their own allowances.
All API calls were read-only inventory, metadata-cost checks and small daily-price/financial availability checks; no bulk market archive backfill or production symbol onboarding was started.
